system.description:
Dreamers are taught a variety of techniques and tricks that can be used to hinder or dissuade attackers, even robots. These traps use nothing but materials found within the natural world.

When you create a Truth that represents a trap or a hindrance placed on an enemy, you may spend 1 Supply Point to enhance the trap or hindrance, doubling any Difficulty increase it causes, and increasing the Difficulty of any Skill Test to remove it by +1.
